Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning (2501.12948v1) · paper method: Table 6 reports AIME 2024 pass@1 of 72.6 for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B versus 47.0 for DeepSeek-R1-Zero-Qwen-32B.

cohort5.claim.deepseekr1.distill-result

  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
  • Version-specific reported method or result; no experiment, proof, raw-corpus record or labor audit was independently reproduced.
  • Scores are percentages estimated with nonzero-temperature sampling, not cons@64. The RL-only comparison is a specific Qwen 32B training run exceeding 10,000 steps (p14).
